mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id AND rp.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.perm_id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND p.status = 1 AND p.perm_code = #{permCode} ORDER BY u.id
